:::{#def-borel-sigma-algebra}
#### Borel $\sigma$-algebra

The **Borel $\sigma$-algebra** on $\reals$, written $\borel$,
is the $\sigma$-algebra generated by (@def-generated-sigma-algebra)
the [collection](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-collection) of all [intervals](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-interval).

:::
